pattern: (System management is locked by the application with pid ([0-9]+)|/var/run/zypp.pid: Resource temporarily unavailable)
remediation: sudo systemctl stop packagekit; sudo kill -9 {match_2} 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -f /var/run/zypp.pid
explanation: PackageKit or another Zypper process is holding the system management lock.

pattern: (Valid metadata not found at specified URL|Download \(curl\) error for .* repository)
remediation: sudo zypper clean -a && sudo zypper ref -f
explanation: Zypper repository metadata cache is corrupted or stale.

pattern: The following package update will NOT be installed because it requires a vendor change
explanation: Zypper prevented an automatic package vendor change without explicit authorization.

pattern: (No space left on device.*btrfs|BTRFS: error .* free space)
remediation: sudo snapper cleanup number && sudo btrfs balance start -dusage=5 /
explanation: Btrfs filesystem has exhausted free blocks due to accumulated Snapper snapshots.
